hub.body: The three most urgent items, across all events. Each line says who has to act and offers the action in one click.

hub.body: Overdue, today, waiting on someone else, then the next fourteen days.

hub.body: Your events in progress, with the countdown and what is left to deal with. One click opens the event summary.

events.body: Your prospects and upcoming events; click a row to open its page.

events.body: A first name and the contact source are enough to start.

events.title: Filters
events.body: Name, status, source, year: the list filters as you type.

events.title: Settings
events.body: « Settings » leads to budget lines, sources and reasons, event types, and planning and schedule templates.

events.title: The calendar
events.body: The coming months: confirmed events in full colour, option dates faded. Click a free date to create a prospect.

quotes.body: Your reusable services: label, unit, price excl. VAT, VAT rate and category. Expand an item to edit it; once archived it is no longer offered but stays on the quotes that use it.

quotes.title: New item
quotes.body: Label, unit and price are enough: the item is offered right away when you compose a quote.

budget.title: Your allocations
budget.body: Each template splits a total budget across your lines, in percentages. It suggests estimated amounts when you simulate an event's budget.

budget.title: New template
budget.body: A name, then a percentage per line; the total must be 100 %. The lines are those of Settings › Budget lines.

event.title: The tabs
event.body: Summary, budget, planning timeline, schedule, couple: each tab groups part of the preparations.

event.title: Summary
event.body: The next action and who must act, the event's health, then the next fourteen days. Details are edited at the bottom.

event.title: Planning timeline
event.body: Tasks month by month, from a template; it starts once the event is confirmed.

event.title: Budget
event.body: One line per service: vendors, status, estimated and committed.

event.title: Search
event.body: A client name, a quote number or a screen: it searches everywhere.

vendors.title: Families
vendors.body: One pill per family, with the number of vendors; pick one to see its types. “To sort” gathers those without a family yet.

vendors.title: Filters
vendors.body: Name, place and distance, already booked: the list follows as you type.

vendors.title: List and map
vendors.body: Hover over a record to see its pin on the map, and vice versa.

vendors.title: New vendor
vendors.body: One record per vendor, found again for every event.

login.title: Logging in
login.body: Enter your account email and password, then the code from your authenticator app. After several failed attempts the account locks for a few minutes to protect it. Forgotten password: use the link below the form.

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.body: The first time, scan the QR code with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy…). After that, enter the 6-digit code it shows each time you log in, or tick "Remember this device": you won't be asked for it on this device for 90 days. After 5 wrong codes, two-factor authentication is blocked for 15 minutes.

home.title: Today
home.body: What needs your attention, across all events, sorted by urgency: overdue, today, waiting on someone else (the client or a vendor), then the next fourteen days. The first three items come first; each line says who has to act and leads to the action in one click. Below, your events in progress, with the countdown.

faq.q: How do I change the follow-up delays for quotes and prospects?
faq.a: In Settings › Follow-up delays: by default, a sent quote after 7 days and a silent prospect after 14 days.

faq.q: Where do I resume a tutorial I started?
faq.a: In Tutorials, in the menu: the tutorial in progress comes first, with the whole path.

faq.q: I ticked a task by mistake?
faq.a: An “Undo” message stays for ten seconds after the tick: it restores the task.

faq.q: Where is the calendar?
faq.a: In Events: the calendar of your weekends is there, with the list.

settings.title: Company and VAT
settings.body: Your company record (SIREN, address, legal form, trade) and your VAT regime: they appear on your quotes and invoices. The trade sets the vocabulary and starter templates. Other settings are filed by section in the left menu.

faq.q: I am moving from the VAT exemption to charging VAT: what do I do?
faq.a: Change the regime here: new quotes and invoices apply the rate; documents already issued do not change.

admin.title: Console overview
admin.body: At a glance: service status, figures across all organisations, what needs action (expired invitations, two-factor authentication not set up, last backup) and activity over the last 6 months. Never an organisation name, amount or content in these figures.

faq.q: Where does the last backup status come from?
faq.a: The nightly backup script reports each run: start, end, result and size. With no success for over 26 hours, the status turns into an alert.

faq.q: What does "active organisation" mean?
faq.a: An organisation where at least one team account has logged in within the last 30 days.

adminSettings.title: Suite settings
adminSettings.body: Regulatory values shared by all organisations, such as the VAT exemption thresholds. Update them when the regulations change.

adminHealth.title: Health
adminHealth.body: Shows whether the application responds and its deployed version, to check the service at a glance.

invitation.title: Creating your account
invitation.body: This invitation link is personal and works only once. Choose your password: you will then set up two-factor authentication.

profile.title: My account and security
profile.body: Choose the language Symbola uses for you. Your password and two-factor authentication protect your account; "Forget all my devices" asks for the code again on trusted devices. "Sign out all my other devices" closes your other sessions, for example after losing a phone.

faq.q: How do I change my password?
faq.a: Log out, then use "Forgot password" on the login screen: a link lets you choose a new one.

faq.q: I have a new phone: how do I set up two-factor authentication again?
faq.a: Ask the suite operator to reset it: you will get an email and scan a new QR code at your next login.

faq.q: How do I add someone to my team?
faq.a: Team accounts are created by the suite operator; the person receives a personal invitation by email.

eventsList.title: Event list
eventsList.body: All your prospects and upcoming events; « Finished » keeps those held or lost. Start with « New prospect », or filter the list by name, status, source or year. To try the module safely, start the guided trial below.

faq.q: Where do I find a past event?
faq.a: In "Past", at the top of the list: it keeps completed and lost events, with the same filters.

faq.q: Why is a year missing from the filter?
faq.a: The filter only offers the years in which you have events, plus the current and next year.

faq.q: Does the guided trial leave anything behind?
faq.a: No: the sample wedding is marked as a trial, excluded from statistics and exports, and deleted when the trial ends.

eventsNew.title: New prospect
eventsNew.body: A partner's first name and the contact source are enough to create the prospect; date, venue and budget can be filled in later. From the calendar, a free date opens this form with the date already set.

faq.q: What is the difference between a prospect and an event?
faq.a: A prospect has not signed yet. It becomes a confirmed event when you change its status on the timeline of its page, or when the quote is signed.

faq.q: A source is missing from the list?
faq.a: Add it in Settings › Sources and reasons; it is offered straight away.

eventsDetail.title: Event page
eventsDetail.body: The whole event, in tabs. The « Summary » opens on the next action and who has to act, then the event's health (planning, budget, client decisions) and the next fourteen days; details are edited at the bottom, under « Edit the details ». The top timeline shows where it stands: click the next step to move forward. The « Next step » banner suggests the next stage (send the quote, apply the planning, create the couple's links). Each tab has a « Settings » link to its templates.

faq.q: How do I mark an event as lost?
faq.a: With the "Mark as lost…" link under the timeline: it asks for the reason, used in your statistics.

faq.q: Why is the planning timeline empty?
faq.a: It starts once the event is confirmed: then apply a template from the Planning timeline tab.

faq.q: The date changes: what happens to the tasks?
faq.a: The app offers to shift the due dates of unfinished tasks; nothing moves without your approval.

faq.q: What does the couple see?
faq.a: What you open to them, through a personal link, with no account or password: their tasks, the schedule, the budget as read-only, never your internal notes. Create their links in the Couple tab; a paying parent can see only some budget categories.

faq.q: How do I share their times with a vendor?
faq.a: In the Couple tab, create a link for a retained vendor: they see the date, the venues, the programme lines that involve their role and your contact details, nothing else (no prices, no budget, no other vendors). Tick “Ask for a code when opening” to have a code sent to their e-mail each time they open it.

faq.q: How do I have the client approve a choice?
faq.a: In the Couple tab, “Client decisions” section: have the client choose between the vendors shown for an item, approve an expense or approve the schedule. The answer is time-stamped and in the person's name; you then retain the vendor or commit the expense in one click. An answered decision is never changed: ask for a new one.

faq.q: How do I move the rest of the programme?
faq.a: In the Programme tab, change an item's start time: the page offers to move the next items by the same amount, start and end, in one click, and "Undo" stays available for ten seconds. When you type, the duration gives the end time, and the other way round; the person in charge is picked from the ones already entered.

faq.q: How do I follow up with a vendor whose contract isn't signed?
faq.a: With « Follow up » on its line, in « Today » or the summary: your mail app opens on a ready message, to the address on its card, and the follow-up is logged in the activity feed.

eventsSettings.title: Budget lines
eventsSettings.body: The lines each new event receives (venue, caterer, photographer…). They were prepared for your trade: add, rename, reorder by dragging. A change applies to upcoming events, not to existing ones.

faq.q: Does changing a line affect existing events?
faq.a: No: only new events get the updated list; add the line by hand to an event already created.

faq.q: Where are sources and loss reasons?
faq.a: In Settings › Sources and reasons, just below in the menu.

eventsTemplates.title: Planning timeline templates
eventsTemplates.body: Your typical task lists, placed before or after the event date (D-365, D-30, the day…). “New template” asks for its name then opens it; you can also load the starter template. Click a template to see its tasks: a task is added or edited in the right-hand panel. A template is applied from a dated event's Planning tab.

faq.q: Does editing a template change ongoing events?
faq.a: No: a template is copied into the event when you apply it; events already prepared do not change.

eventsProgramTemplates.title: Schedule templates
eventsProgramTemplates.body: Your typical wedding-day schedules, moment by moment. “New template” asks for its name then opens it; click a template to see its lines. A line is added or edited in the right-hand panel, without recreating it. A template is applied from an event's Programme tab; participants named after a budget line are linked to it.

faq.q: Can I download the schedule?
faq.a: Yes, from the event page: as a PDF, couple version (without internal notes) or vendor version.

clientEvent.title: Your space
clientEvent.body: Your organiser has opened this space for you with a personal link, with no account or password. At the top, your next three actions and what you are asked to decide; further down, what they have shared with you: your tasks to tick, the schedule of the day, the budget in three figures and its instalments. Paid an instalment? Declare it: your organiser will confirm it. This link is for you only: please do not forward it.

vendorSpace.title: Your vendor space
vendorSpace.body: Your organiser has opened this space for you with a personal link, with no account or password. You will find the date, the venues, the programme times that concern you and how to reach them. This link is for you only: please do not forward it.

budgetSettings.title: Budget allocation
budgetSettings.body: An allocation splits a total budget across your lines, in percentages adding up to 100 %. Create one to suggest estimated amounts when you simulate an event's budget. It is optional: an event has a budget from the start. The alert threshold (90 % by default) raises an alert when an event's committed spending would exceed that share of its envelope.

faq.q: Do I need one allocation per type of wedding?
faq.a: It helps if your weddings fall into price ranges: create several and choose the right one on each budget.

budgetDetail.title: Event budget
budgetDetail.body: Each event line is a category; it holds lines (“Dinner, 120 guests”, “Drinks reception”…), each with its vendor and five amounts: estimated, quoted, committed (filled in when you retain the vendor), paid, and left to pay, calculated. Under each line, attach the quote, contract or invoice, and set the instalments (deposit, balance; a percentage applies to the vendor's committed amount): once paid, they make up the line's paid amount, and the next ones show in “Today”. The envelope is the client's wanted budget; above the alert threshold a banner says so, and retaining a vendor asks for confirmation. Amounts are entered including VAT, each line with its VAT rate (20% by default); if the event's quote is for a business client, the amount excluding VAT shows under each amount. “Export to XLSX” or “to PDF” gives the budget and instalments, in your documents' colours.

faq.q: Does the couple see the budget?
faq.a: Yes, read-only in their portal, if their link opens the Budget section: the whole budget, or only the categories you choose (for a paying parent).

faq.q: Where are attached quotes stored?
faq.a: In private storage, after an antivirus check; they open through a temporary link.

faq.q: Why is the amount excluding VAT not shown?
faq.a: It shows for a business client: choose “Business” as the client type on the event's quote. Without a quote, the client is an individual and the budget stays including VAT.

quotesCatalog.title: Services catalogue
quotesCatalog.body: Your reusable services: label, unit, price excl. VAT, VAT rate and category. Add an item at the bottom of the page; it is offered in your quotes right away. Once archived, it is no longer offered but stays on the quotes that use it.

faq.q: Does changing a price affect quotes already sent?
faq.a: No: the price is copied into the quote when you add the item.

quotesSettings.title: Quotes and invoices
quotesSettings.body: The default validity of your quotes, the numbering series prefixes (quotes, invoices, credit notes, earnest money receipts), your payment terms and the payment methods you accept. Payment terms have two texts: one for individuals and non-professionals, one for business clients, with the late payment penalty rate you choose. Numbers are assigned per year, without gaps. A method you turn off is no longer offered when you record a payment; payments already recorded keep theirs.

faq.q: Can I keep my current numbering?
faq.a: Yes: choose your series prefix; numbers then follow on, year by year.

faq.q: Which penalty rate should I choose for a business client?
faq.a: Both rates offered are lawful: the ECB rate plus 10 percentage points, or three times the statutory interest rate. Use the one in your usual terms. The penalty sentence and the €40 fixed recovery fee are added automatically to your terms for a business client.

quotesDetail.title: Composing a quote
quotesDetail.body: Build the quote from the catalogue or free lines; totals update as you go. Plan the deposits, then send it for signature: once signed, the event becomes « Confirmed ». A sent version is frozen; to change it, create a new version.

faq.q: How do I invoice a deposit?
faq.a: On the signed quote, issue the deposit invoice for that instalment, then the balance invoice at the end.

faq.q: Can an issued invoice be edited?
faq.a: No, it is final: correct it with a credit note, which keeps numbering gap-free.

faq.q: How do I offer options?
faq.a: Tick "Optional" on a line: it shows with its price, out of the total. Once the quote is sent, the client ticks the options they keep on their portal; the total follows, and the choice locks when signing starts. You can also tick for them (choice made over the phone).

faq.q: Why is sending refused?
faq.a: A required mention is missing: insurance, mediator, general terms, VAT number… The message names each field, with a link to where to fill it in. The list of mentions is to be validated by your chartered accountant.

faq.q: Deposit or earnest money?
faq.a: As soon as there is a payment schedule, the quote must say whether advance payments are deposits or earnest money: their effects differ on cancellation. The chosen word appears on the schedule, the PDF and the invoice.

faq.q: How do I generate the contract?
faq.a: Once the quote is sent, choose a template, how the contract is concluded and the optional clauses, then generate. Whatever prevents it is named: empty variable, clause still to draft, missing legal information, deposit clause that does not match. The generated contract is frozen; a change creates a new version.

faq.q: Does the right of withdrawal apply?
faq.a: It depends on how the contract is concluded (at a distance, off-premises) and on the client (consumer). Symbola applies the rules validated by the lawyer; the exception for services on a fixed date is not offered for a wedding. At a distance, the client orders on their portal before signing; they may ask for the service to start before the end of the period.

faq.q: When is the deposit invoice issued?
faq.a: Automatically once everyone has signed, or the day after the withdrawal period ends if the clients did not ask for an immediate start. If a mention is missing, “To do” says so and you issue it in one click once the field is filled in. Earnest money does not trigger an invoice on its own.

faq.q: What if I ask for earnest money?
faq.a: Earnest money is paid in a single instalment and is not invoiced. When you record its payment, Symbola creates a non-tax receipt in its own series. The balance invoice shows the full price, with the earnest money as a payment.

faq.q: How does the balance deduct deposits?
faq.a: Rate by rate: each deposit invoice, net of its credit notes, is deducted from its own VAT rate, both the net amount and the VAT. Deposits and balance add up exactly to the quote.

quotesPayments.title: Upcoming payments
quotesPayments.body: The year's three figures (signed, invoiced, collected), then the unpaid instalments of your quotes, sorted by date with a monthly total. Mark an instalment paid from its quote. An overdue instalment is flagged « Overdue » and shows up in « Today ».

faq.q: Do guided trials count?
faq.a: No, their instalments never appear here.

quotesEReporting.title: E-reporting
quotesEReporting.body: For your private clients, some invoicing data must be declared on your approved platform (from 1 September 2027). Choose a period, check the totals, then download the export to upload.

faq.q: Do I have to send e-invoices to my couples?
faq.a: No: for private individuals, only the data declaration (e-reporting) is required.

importFile.title: Importing data
importFile.body: Choose what you are bringing in: your suppliers or event sheets from your current tool, or another file. The assistant runs through the steps and only asks what needs deciding. Nothing is saved before confirmation, and an import can be undone from the log.

faq.q: What happens to my file?
faq.a: It is checked by the antivirus and then discarded: only its rows are kept, until the import is finished.

importColumns.title: Recognising columns
importColumns.body: Only the columns that need a choice are shown: say what each one becomes, a record field, a free field kept as is, or nothing. A doubtful proposal is never chosen for you. Recognised columns are summed up in one line; “See the detail” opens them.

importMatches.title: Matching existing records
importMatches.body: When a row looks like something already there, the app offers to update it rather than create a duplicate. Filter “To check”, “New”, “Updates”; “Accept all” confirms the safe proposals. You can also match a row by hand.

importGaps.title: Gaps report
importGaps.body: Columns with no match are decided at the “Columns” step. Rows that will not be imported are shown at the “Review and confirm” step, with their reason, and can be downloaded as CSV to be corrected.

importConfirm.title: Confirming an import
importConfirm.body: Before importing, the assistant sums up the effects: records created and updated, types and tags created, columns kept as free fields, rows rejected, with a preview of the corrected values. The button says what will be imported.

importUndo.title: Import log and undo
importUndo.body: Every confirmed import is logged: file, author, date and result. During the undo period you can cancel it: created records are deleted and updated ones go back to their previous values. A record edited since then is flagged and kept.

privacySearch.title: Personal data
privacySearch.body: Look up everything you hold about a person: enter an email, a phone number or a name (accents and case ignored). The search queries each module then the person's events; a module that does not answer is flagged. To export or erase, record the request: its case guides you.

faq.q: Someone asks for their data: what do I do?
faq.a: Record the request, search for the person, tick their records, then export: you get a readable PDF and a ZIP archive.

faq.q: Someone asks to be forgotten?
faq.a: Tick their records, then request the erasure preview: each record is deleted, anonymised or kept as the law requires.

privacyRequests.title: Requests from individuals
privacyRequests.body: Record each request received (access, rectification, erasure, portability, objection) with its date: its case opens with the one-month legal deadline. It guides you to the reply. A close deadline is flagged in the menu and on the home screen.

privacySettings.title: GDPR settings
privacySettings.body: Retention periods (based on the CNIL guidelines, to be checked by a lawyer) and the alert threshold for requests. They feed the monthly purge list, which you always approve.

privacyExport.title: GDPR exports
privacyExport.body: An export answers an access or portability request: a readable PDF and a ZIP archive, kept in private storage and deleted automatically on the date shown. Your internal notes are included: read the export before sending it.

privacyErasure.title: Erasure request
privacyErasure.body: The preview shows, record by record, what will be deleted, anonymised or kept (invoices 10 years, signed quotes 5 years). Once confirmed, each module does its part. Then download the timestamped proof and send the reply: the request closes once the reply is marked sent.

privacyPurge.title: Monthly purge
privacyPurge.body: Each month the list gathers what has passed its retention period: prospects that went nowhere, finished relationships, documents at the end of retention, names of people in requests closed for longer than the set proof period. Approve it: each row is purged, except those you exclude with a reason. Nothing is purged without you.

allTasks.title: Tasks across all your weddings
allTasks.body: The tasks of all your events, sorted by due date. Filter « Overdue » to catch up, or by who does it; tick a task when done. Click it to edit it on its wedding's page.

faq.q: Do the couple's tasks appear here?
faq.a: Yes: they are marked "for the couple", and ticked as soon as the couple completes them in their portal, opened with their personal link.

allQuotes.title: Your quotes
allQuotes.body: All your quotes and invoices, with their status. At the top, the year's three figures: signed, invoiced (less credit notes) and collected (less cancellations, earnest money included). A quote is created from its event's page; deposit and balance invoices from the signed quote. « Settings » leads to numbering, the catalogue and document appearance.

faq.q: Why can't I create a quote here?
faq.a: A quote always belongs to an event: create it from the event page, where it stays linked.

adminAccounts.title: Accounts and support
adminAccounts.body: To unblock someone in a team: see whether their two-factor authentication is set up, whether their account is locked and when they last logged in. "Reset two-factor authentication" is for a lost phone; "Resend invitation" sends a new link. Every action is logged.

faq.q: Someone forgot their password?
faq.a: They change it themselves, with "Forgot password" on the login screen.

adminActivity.title: Organisation activity
adminActivity.body: Usage statistics: accounts, accounts active over 30 days, last login, and the number of events, quotes and invoices created each month. Never a name, an amount or any content; guided trials are not counted.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot password
forgotPassword.body: Enter your account email: a link valid for 30 minutes is sent so you can choose a new password. The message is the same whether or not the address has an account. Your two-factor authentication stays as it is.

adminOnboarding.title: Organisations getting started
adminOnboarding.body: For each team account: tutorials completed and in progress, and the latest help activity. Enough to spot who needs a hand, without any event data.

vendorBook.title: The vendor book
vendorBook.body: Each supplier has a single record, reused from one event to the next. Filter by family with the top chips, then by type, tag, or around a place. A row opens its record on the right; « Archive » removes it from the book after confirmation. The “Rating” filter keeps only vendors rated at least that many stars.

faq.q: How do I compare several quotes for a line?
faq.a: From an event's budget line, add the vendors you consulted, note their quotes, then pick one.

faq.q: A vendor is missing from the map?
faq.a: Their address was not recognised: complete it on their record.

faq.q: Where do I create a vendor type or family?
faq.a: In Settings › Vendor types: create your families and types, rename them, put each type in its family, with the fields specific to it.

faq.q: Two types mean the same thing: how do I bring them together?
faq.a: Open one of them in Settings › Vendor types, then “Merge with another type”: its vendors and own fields join the kept type.

adminOrganizations.title: Organisations
adminOrganizations.body: All organisations in a table: subscribed modules, team accounts, getting started and last login, 20 per page, with a search by name. A row opens its panel: enable or disable its modules (a disabled module is hidden or "unavailable" to the organisation, never an error), see its accounts and getting-started progress. "New organisation" creates it and invites its owner.

faq.q: An organisation did not get its invitation?
faq.a: Resend it from Accounts: a new link is sent and the old one is disabled.

importTypes.title: The file's types
importTypes.body: Each type in the file is sorted into a family: linked to a type in your vendor book, to a starter type created once for all its synonyms, or left “to sort”. Change what a label becomes, or create it in the family of your choice.

eventTypes.title: Event types
eventTypes.body: Each event has a type: wedding, seminar, birthday… The type says who your clients are, the couple or a client, and the event page, the schedule and the client space follow its wording. Rename a type, choose who its clients are, add more; a type that has events can only be deleted by handing them to another type.

quotesDocuments.title: Documents
quotesDocuments.body: The look of your quotes, invoices and credit notes: logo, colour, font, texts and IBAN. The preview updates as you adjust. A document already issued keeps its look; your settings apply to the next ones.

faq.q: Why do headings look darker than my colour?
faq.a: A colour that is too light would be unreadable on white: headings use a darker shade of it.

privacyCase.title: Request case
privacyCase.body: The case guides you to the reply: 1 record, 2 find the data (pre-filled search), 3 erase, export or correct, 4 reply to the person with the ready-to-copy template, 5 close. The legal deadline stays at the top of the case.

faq.q: Why can't I close the request?
faq.a: A request closes once the action is done and the reply is marked as sent: the case lists what is missing.

faq.q: Does the name of the person stay after closing?
faq.a: Yes, as proof of handling, for the set period (5 years by default, Settings tab). The monthly purge then offers to replace it with “[anonymised]”; the type, dates and log of the request stay.

eventsSources.title: Sources and reasons
eventsSources.body: Two lists that help you follow your business. Sources tell where a prospect comes from (Instagram, word of mouth, a fair…): you pick one when creating it. Loss reasons explain why a prospect did not sign: you pick one when marking it « Lost ». Add, rename or remove lines to match the way you work.

faq.q: Does removing a source change my prospects?
faq.a: No: existing prospects keep their source; it is simply no longer offered for new ones.

followUps.title: Follow-up delays
followUps.body: Past these delays, the home screen lists under « To handle » the quotes sent and still unsigned, and the prospects you have not heard from. Shorten them if you follow up quickly, lengthen them if your clients take their time.

vendorTypes.title: Supplier families and types
vendorTypes.body: Each supplier has a type (caterer, florist, venue…), filed in a family that gives its colour on the map. Rename a type, merge two duplicates, move it to another family. Open a type to set its fields (capacity, price, hours…) and choose which ones serve as filters in the book.

faq.q: What happens to the records of a deleted type?
faq.a: Before deleting, you choose the type to move them to, or « to sort ». To keep the type's fields, merge it instead.

vendorTags.title: Tags
vendorTags.body: Tags to describe and find your vendors: a style, a facility, a capacity. Symbola suggests some, sorted by vendor family; your imported tags sort themselves in one click (families, tiers). Add one at the top of the page, put it in a group and choose its families. A “tier” group (capacity, surface…) accepts only one tag per vendor.

vendorTravel.title: Travel estimate
vendorTravel.body: When you look for suppliers around a place, the book estimates each trip's distance and duration: straight-line distance times a detour factor, divided by an average speed. It is deliberately approximate, but instant and free. The example updates as you change a value.

vendorDetail.title: Supplier record
vendorDetail.body: Everything you know about a supplier: contact details, its type's characteristics, tags, rating (1 to 5) and indicative prices, documents, internal note. Click a tag to choose it; only those of its family are shown. « History with you » lists its services, quoted and final price.

faq.q: Does archiving erase its history?
faq.a: No: the record leaves the book, but its services stay on your events and budgets.

vendorNew.title: New supplier
vendorNew.body: A name and a type are enough to create the record; the rest can be filled in later. The address you enter places the supplier on the map, and you can move the point by hand.

search.title: Search
search.body: The top bar searches your whole organisation: events and clients, quotes and invoices, tasks and help pages. Type a name, a quote number or a word like « VAT ». The ⌘K shortcut (Ctrl K on PC) puts the cursor in it from any screen.

tutorials.title: Tutorials
tutorials.body: Tutorials to follow in the suggested order: each one guides you on the real screen, with a fictitious example you can delete at the end. The menu counter shows your progress; a started tutorial can be resumed from here.

setup.title: Getting started
setup.body: Seven steps to prepare your space: trade, company, VAT, your documents, budget lines, sources and reasons, templates. Everything is pre-filled for your trade; review, adjust, then « Confirm and continue ». Optional steps have a « Later » button. Everything can be changed later in Settings.

activityLog.title: Activity log
activityLog.body: Every sensitive action leaves an entry here that nobody can change or delete: sign-ins, access rights, exports, sharing, invoices, payments and deletions. Any access to your data by the Symbola team appears too, with its reason. Filter by period, type or person.

ledgerArchive.title: Accounting archive
ledgerArchive.body: Each invoice, credit note and payment is chained to the previous one by a fingerprint, and each invoice is kept as issued. Download a year's entries for your accountant, find the originals, and check that nothing has been changed. Symbola also checks the chain every night.

team.title: Team
team.body: The accounts of your organization: you, the owner, and your team members. "Remove access" closes a team member's sessions right away, on all their devices, and stops them from signing in again; their work stays in the organization. The removal goes to the activity log.

linkPreview.title: “View as” preview
linkPreview.body: This page shows exactly what the person with this link sees: the same sections, the same figures. Nothing can be changed here and nothing is recorded on their link.

dayOf.title: Day-of
dayOf.body: The day of the event on one dark screen, readable in the sun: “Now” (the current item, in large type, with a call to its vendors) and “Next”, worked out on the phone, even without a network. The bottom bar, within thumb reach, calls the contact of the current item and leads to the schedule, the contacts (emergencies, day-of contacts, vendors, couple: call or text in one tap) and the chosen documents. “Keep on this device” copies the screen to the phone: it then opens without a network, and updates each time it is opened with a network.

faq.q: How do I open the day without a network?
faq.a: The day before, with a network, open the screen from the “Day-of” button on the event and tap “Keep on this device”. On the day, without a network, open Symbola: the “Offline” page lists the days kept.

faq.q: How do I install Symbola on my phone?
faq.a: iPhone: in Safari, tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”. Android: in Chrome, open the ⋮ menu, then “Install app”.

faq.q: When is the copy erased?
faq.a: At midnight the day after the event, when you log out on this device, when another account logs in on it, or with “Remove from this device”. It is not erased when your session expires: the day prepared the evening before stays readable in the morning.

faq.q: What if I lose my phone?
faq.a: “Sign out all my other devices”, from another device, closes its session but cannot reach a phone without a network: the copy stays readable there until the day after the event. Keep your phone locked with a code.

faq.q: How do I keep the seating plan for the day?
faq.a: Add it to the “Documents” tab of the event (PDF or image), then, on the day-of screen, open “Choose the documents to keep” and tick it. Signed quotes, budget documents and quotes from booked vendors can be chosen there too; bank details, never.

faq.q: Where do I add the venue manager or a taxi?
faq.a: In the event's “Schedule” tab, “Day-of contacts” section: name, role and phone. They appear in the day-of directory, below the emergency numbers.

offline.title: Offline
offline.body: Without a network, only the days kept on this device open. The other screens come back with the network.

quotesTemplates.title: Quote templates
quotesTemplates.body: One template per event type: sections, lines, options, standard schedule and deposit or earnest money. "New quote" on the event page starts from the template of its type; editing a template afterwards changes no quote already created, which keeps the version it came from. The starter template is to adapt: prices, terms, schedule.

contractTemplates.title: Contract templates
contractTemplates.body: One template per event type: a title and ordered clauses, each mandatory or optional, with variables in braces and a legal role (pre-contractual information, withdrawal, deposit…). When generating, Symbola fills the variables from the quote, the event and your organisation, and names whatever is missing. Every change increases the version; contracts already generated keep their text. The starter template is a starting point to adapt, to be reviewed by a legal professional: enter the date of the last review.

steps.title: Understand
steps.body: Each event has its page: status, vendors, planning timeline, programme, quotes and clients, organised in tabs. Let's create a fictional birthday party to go through it.

steps.title: Create the example
steps.body: Symbola creates "Camille's 40th birthday party", with its budget and starter tasks.

steps.title: Confirm the event
steps.body: Open the example, Summary tab, and set its status to "Confirmed", as when a client agrees.

steps.title: Retain a vendor
steps.body: In the Budget tab, pick a line (the caterer, for example) and enter the retained vendor's name: it becomes “Retained”.

steps.title: Tick a task
steps.body: In the Planning timeline tab, tick a task as done: the event's progress updates.

steps.title: Finish
steps.body: You know how to follow an event from start to finish. The example will be deleted.

retroplanning-template.keep: Keep the template as a base

steps.title: Understand
steps.body: A planning template lists, once and for all, the tasks of a type of event with their lead time before the day. Applied to an event, it creates every task with its date.

steps.title: Create the example
steps.body: Symbola creates a fictional company retreat and an "Express retreat" template to work from.

steps.title: Look at the template
steps.body: The template appears in Settings › Events › Planning templates: each task has its lead time (90 days before, for example) and who does it.

steps.title: Apply the template
steps.body: Open the example, Planning timeline tab, choose "Express retreat" and click "Apply template": the tasks arrive with their due dates.

steps.title: Move the date
steps.body: In the Summary tab, under "Edit the details", change the event date: Symbola offers to recompute the due dates. Accept and watch them follow.

steps.title: Keep or delete
steps.body: The example event will be deleted. Do you want to keep "Express retreat" as a base for your own templates?

steps.title: Understand
steps.body: The catalogue lists your services with their price, unit and VAT. A quote is built in a few clicks from the catalogue, without retyping anything.

steps.title: Prepare
steps.body: Symbola notes your catalogue's current state to recognise the service you are about to add.

steps.title: Add a service
steps.body: Open the catalogue and add a service: a label, a unit and a price are enough.

steps.title: What it is for
steps.body: In every quote, "Add from catalogue" picks up this service with its price and VAT. Changing the catalogue never changes a quote already sent.

steps.title: Keep or delete
steps.body: Do you keep this service in your catalogue?

steps.title: Understand
steps.body: A quote is written from an event's page, sent, then signed online by your clients. Once signed, it confirms the event.

steps.title: Create the example
steps.body: Symbola creates a fictional wedding and an example quote, already filled with lines and a payment schedule.

steps.title: Send for signature
steps.body: Open the example quote, click "Send the quote" then "Send for signature". During an example no e-mail is sent: the signing links show on the quote.

steps.title: Sign
steps.body: Open a signing link shown on the quote and sign on behalf of each client. The quote becomes "Signed".

steps.title: Finish
steps.body: You know how to get a quote signed online. The example will be deleted.

steps.title: Understand
steps.body: Once the quote is signed, you invoice each deposit of the schedule, then the balance. Numbering is continuous and an issued invoice never changes (corrections go through a credit note).

steps.title: Create the example
steps.body: Symbola creates a fictional gala and its example quote, with a payment schedule.

steps.title: Get the quote signed
steps.body: Open the example quote: send it, send it for signature, then sign through the links shown.

steps.title: Invoice the deposit
steps.body: On the signed quote, in the schedule, click "Invoice" on the deposit. The example invoice uses a separate numbering: it never uses up your real numbers.

steps.title: Invoice the balance
steps.body: Now invoice the balance: it takes the quote total minus the deposits already invoiced.

steps.title: Finish
steps.body: You know how to invoice a deposit then the balance. The example will be deleted.

steps.title: Understand
steps.body: The split suggests an estimated amount per line from a total, then the budget compares estimated and committed as vendors are retained.

steps.title: Create the example
steps.body: Symbola creates a fictional christening to simulate a budget for.

steps.title: Simulate the budget
steps.body: Open the example's budget, enter an envelope and a number of guests, choose an allocation model and run the simulation.

steps.title: Enter a committed amount
steps.body: Enter a committed amount on a line: the difference with the estimate shows, in terracotta if over budget.

steps.title: Finish
steps.body: You know how to simulate and follow a budget. The example will be deleted.

steps.title: Understand
steps.body: The day's programme lists the moments of the event, hour by hour, with the vendors involved. It downloads in two versions: for clients and for vendors.

steps.title: Create the example
steps.body: Symbola creates a fictional wedding with an empty programme.

steps.title: Start from a template
steps.body: Open the example's Day programme tab, choose a programme template and apply it (or add a first line).

steps.title: Download
steps.body: Still in the Programme tab, download the vendors' version: internal notes only appear there, never in the clients' version.

steps.title: Finish
steps.body: You know how to prepare the day's programme. The example will be deleted.

steps.title: Understand
steps.body: Your clients can follow their event's preparation in their own space: their tasks, the programme and the budget, never your internal notes or your other events.

steps.title: Create the example
steps.body: Symbola creates a fictional wedding anniversary, with its tasks.

steps.title: The Clients tab
steps.body: In the Couple tab of the example, you will create a personal link for each client: no account, no password (during an example, no link is sent). You can remove a link at any time.

steps.title: What they see
steps.body: In the planning timeline, "Clients" tasks are the ones they will see and can tick; their ticks appear in your activity feed.

steps.title: Finish
steps.body: You know how to open your clients' space. The example will be deleted.

steps.title: Understand
steps.body: Import brings in your existing data: the PDF event sheets from your current tool, or a table (Excel, CSV or JSON). You check a preview, then confirm. A confirmed import can be undone during the undo period.

steps.title: Prepare
steps.body: Symbola notes your current imports to recognise the one you are about to start.

steps.title: Start an import
steps.body: Open Import data, download the example sheet (a fictitious PDF) from “Bring over my events”, then choose “Event sheets (PDF)” and drop it in. Go as far as the preview.

steps.title: Check before confirming
steps.body: The preview shows the event that will be created, with its suggested status, and any rejected sheets with their reason. Nothing is saved until you confirm: as this is a test, abandon the import.

steps.title: Finish
steps.body: You know how to bring over your existing events, one or several sheets at a time.

steps.title: Understand
steps.body: For one budget line (the caterer of a gala, the venue of a retreat…), you often consult several vendors. Symbola keeps them side by side with their quote and your notes until you select one.

steps.title: Prepare
steps.body: Symbola creates an example event (a charity gala) and, if you have the vendor book, two example caterers. Everything will be deleted at the end.

steps.title: Consult two vendors
steps.body: In the example's “Caterer” budget line, add two consulted vendors: pick them from your vendor book or simply type their name.

steps.title: Record a quote
steps.body: For one of them, enter the quote amount (or attach the file). You can also add a note, internal or shown to the clients.

steps.title: Retain
steps.body: Click “Retain” on the vendor you choose: it becomes “Retained”, the line is committed at its amount, and the other one stays visible as “Dismissed”.

steps.title: What the clients see
steps.body: Tick “Show to clients” on a vendor: your clients find it in their space with the notes ticked “Clients”, never your internal notes.

steps.title: Finish
steps.body: The example and its example vendors will be deleted.

steps.title: Understand
steps.body: Your quotes and invoices carry your logo, colour, details and terms. A document already issued keeps its appearance: your settings apply to the next ones.

steps.title: Complete your details
steps.body: In Business and VAT, enter at least your SIRET or contact email, and your VAT number if you have one. They are printed in the header and footer.

steps.title: Upload your logo
steps.body: In Settings › Sales › Documents, upload your logo (PNG or JPEG, 2 MB max). Without a logo, your documents show your business name.

steps.title: Choose the colour and font
steps.body: Pick one of the shades or your own colour, and the Modern or Classic font, then save. A colour that is too light is darkened to stay readable.

steps.title: Review the texts and enter your IBAN
steps.body: Review the quote terms and the payment terms, enter your IBAN, then save. The IBAN is printed on your invoices and under your quotes' payment schedule.

steps.title: Download a sample
steps.body: Download a sample quote or invoice as a PDF: it is what your clients will receive. No number is used up.

steps.title: Finish
steps.body: Your quotes and invoices now look like you. You will find these settings in Settings › Sales › Documents.
